applicability: Normal-incidence absorption of a homogeneous, rigid-backed porous layer within the Delany-Bazley empirical fit's validated normalized-frequency range
assumptions: Delany-Bazley (1970) empirical fit, valid for 0.01 <= X <= 1.0
uncertainty: Empirical curve fit; flow resistivity, thickness and frequency are taken as declared, not measured. A computed absorption coefficient outside [0,1] indicates the fit itself has broken down for this thickness/frequency combination and is reported, not clamped.
limits_policy: Explicit caller-declared minimum target absorption, not a presumed standard.
